analysis: The trial succeeded operationally and achieved host validation macro HR@10 of 0.4975: Movies_and_TV 0.585, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.530, Electronics 0.360, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.515. This improves the supplied prior result of 0.4912 by 0.0063, but remains 0.0075 below the baseline of 0.505. Electronics declined from the reported prior 0.375 to 0.360, so the residual did not demonstrate the intended recovery there. The aggregate gain supports further investigation but does not establish weakened current-item information as the cause; learned gate values and repeated-run evidence were not provided. Training consumed 791.36 allocated GPU-seconds.
code_summary: One independently trained SASRec model per category, with 96-dimensional embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks, two attention heads, dropout 0.2, and history length 64. A jointly learned scalar g initialized to -2 adds sigmoid(g) times the normalized current-item embedding after final LayerNorm and before feature L2 normalization. Training and inference share this representation. Scores use normalized candidate embeddings, a learned scale, and jointly learned item biases. Training retains global sampled cross-entropy, 256 negatives, at most 24 transitions per history, prefix augmentation, and AdamW. Each category loads exactly one selected checkpoint through the shared SASRec definition with strict state-dict loading, including g; no ensemble or separately fitted scoring component is used.
